استهوين (form X)
# اِسْتَهْوَيْنَ (istahwayna) /is.tah.waj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَهْوَى (istahwā)
# اُسْتُهْوِينَ (ustuhwīna) /us.tuh.wiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَهْوَى (istahwā)
# اِسْتَهْوِينَ (istahwīna) /is.tah.wiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَهْوَى (istahwā)
